as_told.title: Washington Post reveals the Greenbrier bunker

plain: This story is about a secret underground bunker at the Greenbrier, a place in West Virginia. A writer and researcher, Bryce Zabel, says that nobody knew about the bunker until a newspaper, he thinks the Washington Post, broke the story in the 1990s. According to him, it was where Congress was to be evacuated in the event of nuclear war, and he adds there is another such site. He tells it to make a point: the government can keep large hidden facilities secret for decades, so other hidden places might exist too. The same words also appear credited to a journalist, Brent Friedman, on a later episode of the same podcast, so the two tellings disagree only about who said it.
